verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Codex cloud runs tasks in isolated cloud environments and in parallel without tying up your local machine. The docs frame this as delegating a longer task and returning when it is ready. Supporting docs cover per-repo environment setup (dependencies, variables, setup steps), reviewing the diff or opening a PR, and submitting work from the CLI via `codex cloud`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud background-task workflow, and detail on how the environment isolation actually works.
